description: Street Trees, Borough is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Numbers of street trees by borough. These data were collected by the London Assembly Environment Committee for its update report on the future for London's street trees. They contain data supplied by London borough tree departments and the Mayor's Street Tree Programme. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The publisher named on the listing is Greater London Authority. Its keywords include environment, trees. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
